paper_title: First results of the SUPAX Experiment: Probing Dark Photons
notes: SUPAX cavity haloscope, single-frequency proof-of-concept limit. Headline result (Eq. 18 and conclusion): chi < (6.20 +- 3.15(exp) +- 9.65(SG)) x 10^-14 at 95% CL, at cavity resonance f0 = 8303.06 MHz = 34.34 ueV (m = 3.434e-5 eV), for a randomly polarised dark photon field. A single point (single frequency). The fixed-polarisation scenario gives chi_pol < 38e-14 (factor ~6 weaker); the randomised-polarisation value is the paper's stated main claim. rho_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (Table II). Figure 9 is adapted from an external compilation (Ref. [15]) and was not used as the source.
